scope: Isolated loopback HTTP/1.1, memory storage, authentication disabled, demo providers; server and load client share this machine.
limitations: Not a gateway, database, TLS, cluster, 10000-stream or production SLO test.
Latency includes Node fetch and same-machine client scheduling; no CPU/RSS/FD profiling included.
Task case measures create plus cancel; demo stream duration is deliberately paced.

All demo chat requests share one workspace. First delta includes execution queue wait; workspace concurrency is now 2 while client concurrency is 4, so this is not comparable with the previous 4-active-chat baseline.

media_lanes.query_includes: native phased providers: status and manifest transaction; legacy demo has no real download
media_lanes.delivery_includes: private download, import and candidate handoff
media_lanes.review_includes: first review only, shared engine permits and final persistence
media_lanes.measurement: create plus cancel only; not media execution, queue fairness or moderation throughput
